findings.summary: In batch mode, rollbackFix is redundantly called inside a loop for every unresolved comment when the escalation budget is reached, resetting the tree multiple times.
findings.suggested_fix: Extract the rollbackFix call and its warning check outside the `for (const output of unresolvedOutputs)` loop so it only runs once per batch failure.

findings.summary: In batch mode, comments blocked at the escalation budget are not updated with `blocked: true` in the taskResults array, resulting in an under-reported blocked count.
findings.suggested_fix: Mutate `output.blocked = true;` inside the escalation budget loop when blocking the comment so that the existing object reference in taskResults reflects the blocked state.
